test.create_query: CREATE TABLE json_src (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO json_src SELECT concat( '{"header":{"id":"', toString(generateUUIDv4()), '","source":{"name":"p', toString(number % 40), '","group":"v', toString(number % 40), '"}},', '"kind":', toString(number % 7), ',"level":', toString(number % 5), ',"message":"m', toString(number), '",', '"endpoint":{"ip":"10.0.', toString(number % 256), '.1","port":', toString(number % 65536), '},', '"extra":{"f', toString(number % 320), '":1},', '"payload":{', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('"k', toString((number % 40) * 30 + i), '":"x', toString(i), '"'), range(30)), ','), '}}') FROM numbers(100000)
test.query: SELECT s::JSON(max_dynamic_paths=64, `header.id` UUID, `header.source.name` String, `header.source.group` String, kind Int64, level Int64, message String, `endpoint.ip` Nullable(String), `endpoint.port` Int64) FROM json_src FORMAT Null
